title: Spider-Woman #1 Marvel 1993 Newsstand Julia Carpenter Death-Web Vol 2 Czop
conditionDescription: Light spine wear and small creases along the left edge of the front cover; back cover toned with light edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Spider-Woman #1 (November 1993, vol. 2), Marvel Comics - first issue of the Julia Carpenter mini-series. "Rematch with Death-Web!" Written by Roy Thomas, cover by Paul Czop. Newsstand edition, $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: Tiger Electronics X-Men handheld game ad.

Condition: light spine wear and small creases along the left edge of the front cover; back cover toned with light edge wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
